name: bucket-fill-empty
comment: WP-2.6. ItemBucket.onItemRightClick through use_item (sendPlaceBlock on a stone block does nothing, then sendUseItem): the eye ray (EntityPlayer at (0.5, 61, 0.5), eye 1.62 up, 5 blocks; it stops on liquid sources only for the empty bucket). Stone y 58-60 with a still water source at (0, 60, 2), still lava at (2, 60, 2) and a channel (-2, 60, 2..3) fed by a flowing source at (-2, 60, 4). t 2: the empty bucket at the water (yaw 0, pitch 40) becomes a water bucket (Replaced); t 4: the water bucket's ray passes the emptied cell and hits the stone behind, the water goes back as a source in front of that face. t 7: the same for lava (yaw -45, pitch 30); t 9: the lava bucket's ray crosses the emptied cell's corner and hits stone (3, 60, 3) on its -x face, whose front cell (2, 60, 3) is solid: nothing placed, the stack kept; t 11: at yaw -40 it hits (2, 60, 3) on its -z face and the lava goes into the emptied cell. t 31: toward the flowing channel (yaw 45) the empty bucket's ray passes the flowing water (BlockFluid.canCollideCheck: sources only) and hits stone: the stack is kept (used false). t 33: milk gives an empty bucket for any block hit. t 36/37: looking up (pitch -90) nothing is hit. t 39: a water bucket aimed at the pit again.
